Build clean now, 0 errors. Two real bugs, both from bundler bump, deprecation spam was noise:

- `src/core/options.js` — options shape changed to `retryCount`, code still read `options.retries` (undefined `.toFixed` crash). Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — new config loader leaves unset flag `undefined` instead of `false`; strict check threw on that. Now treats `undefined` same as `false`.

Remaining 8 warnings = deprecation/lint noise, no action needed.
